SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Miscellaneous 44/34 Gor. Rd.
REPORT
Further re
Subject (in full) Warrant for arrest of Bus Driver, 407 Wong Zang Kwei.
Made by D.S.I. Rhind Forwarded by [Signature]

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE File No. S. B. REGISTRY. No. D 5935 Gordon Road Station, Date June 9th 12 / 6 / 34）

At 11.30 a.m. on 9-6-34 on verbal instructions from D.D.C. I
I went to the premises of the Bus Company situated at 1171 Connaught
Road and produced before Mr. Shetter, the Manager, a S.S.D. Court
Warrant of Arrest for Bus Driver 407 Wong Zang Kwei (王長貴) and
requested assistance to execute it, the document having been duly
countersigned by M.B.M.'s Court Registrar. Mr. Shetter informed
me that Bus Driver No. 407 Wong Zang Kwei is at present on leave
from his employment and is not due to resume until June 18, 1934.
I requested particulars of the driver's address and Mr. Shetter
called for the man's record card. This was found to bear the
address of 17 Robison Road, which particulars were supplied by the
driver at the time of engagement. A visit to Robison Road however
proved that this address is not longer existent.

As the Warrant expires at 12 midnight on 9-6-34 it will
be returned to Superintendent Whiting i/c Judicial Police along
with a copy of this report for his information.

Office i/c Special Branch. [Signature]

[Handwritten annotation: 抄 / 办]

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
杂项 44/34 戈登路
报告
事由（全称）：关于逮捕公交车司机、编号407的王长贵（Wong Zang Kwei）的逮捕令事宜。
由副督察长（D.S.I.）林德（Rhind）呈报，经 [签名] 转递

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 档案号 S. B. 登记处。编号 D 5935 戈登路捕房，日期 1934年6月9日 12 / 6 / 34）

1934年6月9日上午11时30分，奉代理副总巡官（D.D.C. I）口头指示，
我前往位于康纳脱路（Connaught Road）1171号的公交车公司办公处，
向经理谢特（Shetter）先生出示了针对公交车司机、编号407的王长贵（王長貴）的上海特区地方法院（S.S.D. Court）逮捕令，
并请求协助执行该逮捕令，该文件已由工部局董事会法院（M.B.M.'s Court）书记官正式会签。谢特先生告知我，
编号407的公交车司机王长贵目前休假中，预计至1934年6月18日才复职。
我要求提供该司机的住址详情，谢特先生调取了该员工的记录卡。
记录卡上显示的地址为罗宾森路（Robison Road）17号，此为该车手受雇时提供的信息。
然而，经前往罗宾森路查访，证实该地址已不存在。

鉴于该逮捕令将于1934年6月9日午夜12时到期，
现将逮捕令连同本报告副本一并交还负责司法警务的惠廷（Whiting）警司，供其知悉。

特别部门办公室负责人。[签名]

[手写批注：抄 / 办]
